translation: When the middle region is straight in the center, it is the hand Absolute Yin Heart Governor; when it moves it causes heart pain, red face with much anger and joy, and bitter taste with difficulty swallowing. Slightly floating causes bitter grief and trance; rough is cold below the heart; deep is fear and terror, like the appearance of one about to be seized, with occasional chills and fever, and blood and qi. When the rear region is straight in the center, it is the hand Greater Yin Lung and hand Yang Ming Large Intestine; when it moves it causes cough, rebellious qi with inability to breathe; floating is wind, deep is heat, tight is accumulated heat in the chest, rough is occasional coughing of blood.
